title: AutumnOS repository display metadata, schema 1
description: Root autumn.store.json on the repository's actual default branch. Duplicate JSON keys are forbidden. Topics determine the visible classification; category is only checked for disagreement.

url.description: Optional HTTPS public DNS URL without credentials, query or fragment. Never automatically executed.

screenshots.description: HTTPS URLs. Rendering supports only same-repository github.com/owner/repo/blob/ref/path or raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/repo/ref/path PNG/JPEG through the GitHub Contents API; 2 MiB and bounded pixel dimensions. No SVG/HTML/external content is executed.
